name: Federal Freight Company (AO FGK)
via: shares held by OAO RZD (100% reported in 2013; RZD considered selling a 49% stake in January 2026)
note: Kommersant (16 Jan 2026): RZD may sell 49% of the FGK shares it owns at an open auction; the packet's sale was to be discussed at RZD's board in Q2 2026. CFTS (2013, citing FGK's own statement) reported RZD owns 100% of FGK.
